signature.name: Already-pouring first frame
signature.description: Scores whether the loader already shows coffee being made in the first frame a customer sees after tapping order, at 120px, with no beat needed to start the motion.

lesson: Strong coffee loaders show coffee moving into the cup from the first frame, in a shape a half-awake eye reads at 120px; weak ones show a dot or a turning rosette.

bare-wire.signature_why: A crema cup is there at 0ms, but the hole opens only at 0.3s, so the start reads as a settled cup rather than a pour already happening.
bare-wire.loved: Calm, one-beat rhythm with no spinner rotation, and the cup still reads as coffee at a glance.
bare-wire.docked: The dark hole reads as a dot or bullseye inside the cup at 120px, not as coffee arriving.
bare-wire.fix_note: Refused with a reason: a drip stroke outside the cup reads as a second subject, so the team enlarged the held scar instead. The reason is fair, but the hole still looks like a dot to me.

warm-hands.signature_why: The stream and the spiral are both in place at frame one, so a restart reads as the pour carrying on.
warm-hands.loved: The pour looks like someone is making coffee, and the stream into the spiral is an ownable coffee-ritual image.
warm-hands.docked: The spiral still turns 360 degrees and at 120px can read as a spinner or a cinnamon roll, and the stream looks like a straw.
warm-hands.fix_note: Idea taken but geometry changed: they made a static stream from the top edge to the pivot, always visible, not a line to a moving tip. It helps the pour read, but the spiral still turns.

the-glitch.signature_why: At 0ms the cup is dark with no drop; the drop shows by 250ms, but the near-full frame before the swap makes the restart look like a drain.
the-glitch.loved: A drop falls into the cup once a second and the crema steps up, so at 120px it reads as coffee coming in. The orange is gone.
the-glitch.docked: The crema can look nearly full at 4.6s and then empties in a 0.25s swap, so the loop can read as a fill-and-drain.
the-glitch.fix_note: Landed and then some: they removed the orange band and ghost at every size, not only at 120px, and kept the one-second drop and the five-step count, now in crema.
